helpSupport.title: Help & Support

welcome.title: How can we help you?
welcome.description: Get quick answers to your questions or contact our support team for personalized assistance.

trackOrder.question: How do I track my order?
trackOrder.answer:
You can track your order by:

1. Going to "My Orders" in your profile
2. Selecting the order you want to track
3. Viewing the real-time status updates
4. Messaging our team from Help & Support if anything looks wrong

We provide SMS updates for all order status changes.

cancelOrder.question: Can I cancel or modify my order?
cancelOrder.answer:
Yes, you can cancel or modify your order:

• Within 2 hours of placing the order
• Before it enters "Processing" status
• By contacting us immediately

To cancel: Go to "My Orders" and tap "Cancel Order" or message us from Help & Support.

deliveryAreas.question: What areas do you deliver to?
deliveryAreas.answer:
We deliver throughout the Kurdistan Region of Iraq:

• Erbil and surrounding areas
• Sulaymaniyah and suburbs
• Dohuk and nearby cities
• Zakho, Akre, Koya, Shaqlawa
• Other major cities in KRI

Delivery time: 1-3 business days within cities, 2-5 days for remote areas.

deliveryCost.question: How much does delivery cost?
deliveryCost.answer:
Delivery charges:

• Free delivery on orders over $500
• Standard delivery: $15
• Express delivery (same day): $25
• Remote areas: Additional $10

Free delivery applies to all major cities in KRI.

paymentMethods.question: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.answer:
We accept multiple payment methods:

• Cash on Delivery (COD)
• QI Card payments
• FIB Bank cards
• Bank transfers
• Mobile wallet payments

All electronic payments are secure and encrypted. COD is available for all orders.

genuineParts.question: Are your products genuine and authentic?
genuineParts.answer:
Yes, we guarantee:

• 100% genuine, authentic products
• Sourced from trusted suppliers
• Full warranty coverage
• Quality assurance certificates
• Authenticity verification

All products come with official packaging and documentation.

warranty.question: Do you offer warranties on products?
warranty.answer:
Yes, comprehensive warranty coverage:

• Genuine products: 12-24 months warranty
• Electronics: Up to 24 months
• Accessories: 12 months
• Manufacturing defects: Fully covered
• Service warranty: 6 months

Warranty covers manufacturing defects and normal use.

resetPassword.question: How do I reset my password?
resetPassword.answer:
To reset your password:

1. Tap "Forgot Password" on login screen
2. Enter your registered email
3. Check your email for reset link
4. Follow the instructions in the email
5. Create a new strong password

If you don't receive the email, check spam folder or contact us.

installation.question: Do you offer product setup or installation?
installation.answer:
Yes, we offer professional setup and installation:

• Certified technicians
• Installation at our service center
• Mobile installation service available
• Competitive rates
• Installation warranty included

To schedule, message us from Help & Support.

returns.question: Can I return or exchange products?
returns.answer:
Return and exchange policy:

• 7-day return policy
• Products must be unused and in original packaging
• Manufacturing defects: Full refund
• Wrong item ordered: Exchange available
• Other issues: Consultation provided

Contact us within 7 days for returns or exchanges.
